מה חדש: נוקו טקסטים משובשים שנותרו מתהלי: What's new: Cleaned up garbled text left over from the translation process — in a few places the menu showed the translation engine's own internal text instead of the actual translation. Every case was fixed in all languages, and an automatic build check now prevents it from coming back.
מה חדש: שמות הציוד, שיטות הבישול ותוויות: What's new: Equipment names, cooking methods and the recipe's cook-stage labels now translate in every language — some previously showed in English or Hebrew inside a translated interface. A new check catches both leftover Hebrew and stray English in the translation.
מה חדש: עוד אזורים בממשק מתורגמים כעת בכ: What's new: More of the interface now translates in every language — the portion calculator, the prep and smoking notes, the equipment-occupancy labels, and the home-screen tips. Some of these previously appeared in English inside a translated interface.
